Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BodySizeImpactsS: When enabled (checked), the size of the body has an effect on the distance.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BaseEatTime_tool:
This value is used to calculate how long a body takes to be eaten.
It is in real world seconds.
The actual time taken to consume a corpse is adjusted by:
- Size of the body relative(ish) to a human.
- Number of zombies eating the body.
- Current game speed.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_EatCooldownMulti:
This value controls how often a zombie can eat.
At 1.0, a zombie will not eat again for the same amount of game time they spent eating.
The cooldown increases as they eat, and does not require a body to be fully consumed.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_EatSyncFrequency:
Time in milliseconds between syncing eat progress.
Values greater than 1000 may reduce the accuracy of Base Eat Time.
This is intended for multiplayer usage, to reduce network traffic and log spam caused by RPC.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_ItemDestroyChanc: When a body is consumed, every individual item has this chance of being destroyed.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_AllowWornAttache:
When enabled (checked), worn/attached items will be visible on the skeleton.
This can look weird.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BodyStartDistanc: Body smell distance will always start at this value.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BodyMaxDistance_: Maximum potential distance of dead body smell
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BodyAgeMultiplie: Bodies will have their age (world hours) multiplied by this value, which is then added to the smell distance.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BodyWindSpeedMul:
This value is used to determine how much impact the wind speed has on the smell of bodies.
Higher values increase the effect.
Wind has a significant impact on smell distance.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_BodyDispersionAn:
This angle is used to determine whether a zombie falls inside an area that is projected from bodies in the direction of the wind, up to the smell distance.
Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_CanSmellPlayer_t: When enabled (checked), zombies will be able to smell players.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_PlayerInterruptF: When enabled (checked), zombies will stop feeding and target the player, if they smell the player.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_PlayerStartDista: Player smell distance will always start at this value.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_PlayerMaxDistanc: Maximum potential distance of player's smell.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_PlayerBloodMulti: The amount of blood on a player, and on items in their inventory, will be multiplied by this value, which is then added to smell distance.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_PlayerWindSpeedM:
This value is used to determine how much impact the wind speed has on the smell of the player.
Higher values increase the effect.
Wind has a significant effect on smell distance.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_PlayerDispersion:
This angle is used to determine whether a zombie falls inside an area that is projected from players in the direction of the wind, up to the smell distance.
Set to 0 disable.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_TemperaturePeak_:
Temperature above this value increases smell distance.
Temperature below this value decreases smell distance.
This value is in celsius.
Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_RainMultiplier_t:
Adjusts how much rain reduces smell distance.
Higher values increase the effect.
Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_FogMultiplier_to:
Adjusts how much fog increases smell distance.
Higher values increase the effect.
Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_RandomSensitivit: When enabled (checked), zombies are assigned a random sensitivity to smell.
Sandbox_StarvingZombies_ZMultiplier_tool:
Z coordinate of zombies, bodies and players are multiplied by this value.
When this value is greater than 1.0, it artificially increases the distance between zombies and bodies/players that are on different levels.
